grouping_and_normalization.reference_frequency_groups: Same own-reference frequency alone is a descriptive grouping. Different reference epochs, drifts or widths can imply different transported physical paths.
grouping_and_normalization.raw_geometry_identity: A raw profile's physical identity is original source scan plus width and all16absolute rounded score-cell centers. For a template spanning sixscans, compare the entire sixscan family of these identities.
grouping_and_normalization.normalized_measurement_equivalence: Identical raw-cell paths do not ensure identical scores if their fixed physical4096normalization-core anchors or normalization terms differ. Track raw-geometry groups and normalized-measurement groups separately.
grouping_and_normalization.no_physical_source_claim: Even distinct physical measurement templates can be aliases of the same underlying stationary/intermittent interference. Group counts are not source counts.
grouping_and_normalization.followup_anchor: For fixed context profiles, preserve each selected original map's physical4096core anchor in every scan. Explicitly identify reused versus newly computed full16normalizations, algorithm/input hashes and full501halo support.
grouping_and_normalization.baseline_reuse: A previous capsule may be reused only for exactly identical raw geometry; previous fixed scores require normalized-measurement equivalence as well. A full12096crop can support other paths only after every501median support is geometrically verified.
grouping_and_normalization.context_extrapolation: Compute cross-scan elapsed times in original order: (context_tstart-primary_tstart)*86400 + row*TSAMP; equal midpoint half-integrations cancel. Never refit drift or width in the context.
grouping_and_normalization.context_DC: Own-window DC eligibility does not guarantee transported context boxes avoidDC. Report those contacts without adapting the selected shortlist afterward.
